We are looking for a technician to join the termination department of a technical production company in the Rotterdam area. • Working with precision tools to perform accurate and clean finishing 
• Testing and troubleshooting completed assemblies when necessary 
• Collaborating with other departments (engineering, testing, QA) to ensure quality standards 
This work requires patience, focus, and technical ability. Mistakes can be costly, so experience and responsibility are essential. 
Candidate Profile 
We are looking for candidates who: 
• Have experience in panel building, fine electrical assembly, or cable harnessing
